**derived** — Proves AG-7 for text `equals`, one condition, as a flat request in the shape AG Grid Community's Infinite Row Model sends (`startRow`, `endRow`, `sortModel`, `filterModel`; no group, value, pivot or context fields). Written from AG Grid's published filter model types and the matching server-side case's request (the group fields removed), not recorded from a running grid; fields AG Grid 35+ adds that the parser ignores (a sort item's `type`, `filterModel: {}` when nothing is set) are not modelled here (`ag-grid-majors/005` and `006` cover them). Oracle: none that `scripts/check-community-oracle.py` can use (the nearest single-condition text `equals` is `dialect-parity/006`, which also carries the SQL dialect arms this family leaves out); the artifacts are `operators/001-eq-string`'s with its second OR arm removed (the first arm: `status = $1`, `$eq`, one `term`), the dataset is 001's and the expected rows are the rows 001's first arm keeps. SEM-2: `eq` never matches null.
